subject: Co-sell enablement + marketplace technical handoff (DataForge)
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@dataforge.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-eng@dataforge.com
Date: 2028-03-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + co-sell kickoff: DataForge listing strategy

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. As discussed, DataForge is ready to move our listing into AWS and GCP marketplaces but we want to align on the co-sell and technical evidence flow first. I attached the SOW we signed (DataForge_CoSell_SOW_v2.pdf) and a short internal checklist.

Primary asks for this thread:
- Confirm the evidence package Redwood needs to enable co-sell (telemetry, billing SKU mapping, support matrix).
- Share a minimal-runbook for on-prem customers that will be referenced in the listing.
- Point us to the canonical DocuSign + HubSpot links so our procurement team can track the commit.

Target launch: mid-April (we have a sales event April 20).

I'm looping in our marketplace engineering lead (marketplace-eng@dataforge.com) to coordinate artifacts.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Partnerships
DataForge Consulting
[Attachment: DataForge_CoSell_SOW_v2.pdf]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Lena Park <lena.park@dataforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + co-sell kickoff: DataForge listing strategy

Hi Lena — welcome and really excited to partner on this. Quick notes and next steps: 

Thanks for the SOW — saw the attachment. I spoke with our marketplace team and pulled together the items you'll need for a co-sell ready listing: 
- Technical evidence: integration guide, performance benchmarks, security matrix (SOC2 scope), and customer reference snapshot.
- Billing/entitlement: SKU map for AWS/GCP, metering labels for marketplace, and the recommended pricing tiers.
- Support/ops: runbook for install/onboarding + escalation path (24/7 support vs business hours).

Vivek, can you add the minimal runbook snippet and confirm whether the deployment-runbook.md we maintain is ok to share as-is or needs redaction?

Ben — can you confirm the marketplace SKU naming convention and whether we should reuse Redwood's co-sell SKU template.

I'll also share a Drive folder and a DocuSign link for the SOW so procurement can see status.

Let me know if mid-April is still the target and any blockers on your side.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Partner Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: aws-marketplace-listing-checklist.xlsx]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Lena Park <lena.park@dataforge.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + co-sell kickoff: DataForge listing strategy

Nice to meet you, Lena — congrats on the progress. Short answers: 

SKU and metering: use the pattern REDWOOD-DF-<PRODUCT>-METER. We'll provide a mapping table in the Drive folder (I attached an initial sheet). For co-sell entitlements, we typically surface a "standard" and "pro" SKU and one metered add-on.

Pricing: keep your public listing at list-price and send us the committed discount tiers for co-sell offers. We can handle the deal registration flow through our partner portal and push to HubSpot.

Next: I'll upload a completed SKU map by EOD and flag any naming conflicts.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Channel & Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: initial-sku-map.csv]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@dataforge.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + co-sell kickoff: DataForge listing strategy

Hi all — I reviewed DataForge's runtime notes and the SOW. Quick technical checklist and a few asks: 

Minimal artifacts we can publish from Redwood side:
- deployment-runbook.md (sanitized) with steps for VPC peering and KMS key hints.
- sample telemetry config to surface token-level metrics for co-sell reporting.
- an estimated latency/throughput benchmark for the primary model bundle.

A couple of asks for your engineers: 
1) Can you provide a short diagram of your auth flow (OIDC/SAML) so we can document SSO options in the listing?
2) Do you have an aggregated list of sample customers we can use as references for the marketplace listing (name + one-line use case)?

I'll prepare the sanitized runbook and upload to the Drive folder by EOD. Also marked where we need SOC2 scope language redacted.

— Vivek
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deployment-runbook.md]

From: Lena Park <lena.park@dataforge.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, partners@aws-marketplace.com
Date: 2028-03-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + co-sell kickoff: DataForge listing strategy

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. A few confirmation points from procurement and product: 
- Mid-April launch still works, contingent on SKU map and sanitized runbook being in place by next Thursday (2028-03-29).
- I'll circulate a one-page customer reference list (three names) by EOD tomorrow.
- DocuSign is live for the SOW (https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-DataForge-SOW) — procurement shows signed status pending a couple of minor redlines which Lena will confirm this afternoon.

If we get the runbook and SKU map in the Drive folder, we can request the AWS co-sell tag and start the joint GTM planning.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Partnerships
DataForge Consulting
